svg.title: Heirloom architecture
svg.desc: Heirloom architecture. Left, what the reactive contract listens to: the owner's token transfers on each watched chain (value above zero counts as life; a zero-value transferFrom is struck through), an owner-independent Chainlink feed as a canary, and Reactive's Cron topic as the only clock. Centre, on the Reactive Network: HeirloomReactive.react() filters first, stamps lastSeen, moves ARMED, GRACE, EXPIRED, DONE, and calls the system contract (subscribe, unsubscribe, requestCallbackV_1_0). Right, on Base: the callback proxy calls sync() on HeirloomVault, which moves ARMED, GRACE, CLAIMABLE, CLAIM_PENDING, RELEASED and emits logs the reactive contract subscribes to; a two-step claim, initiateClaim then finalizeClaim, that anyone may press, pays the heir.
